perception.note: Low light vision, emotion sense 120 feet

generalAbilities.name: Emotion Sense 120 feet
generalAbilities.description: A teraphant can sense the emotions of creatures within 120 feet as an imprecise sense. Emotion sense is a precise sense against creatures under an emotion effect. A creature under the effects of Calm can't be noticed via emotion sense.

defensiveAbilities.name: Empathetic Response
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 60 feet of the teraphant is targeted by a spell or ability with the emotion trait

Effect The teraphant also benefits from the spell or effect, as though it were an additional target for 1 minute or until the triggering spell or ability ends.

offensiveAbilities.name: Impale
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirement The teraphant has a creature grabbed

Effect The teraphant slams the creature onto one of its horns. The target must attempt a Basic DC 27 Reflex Saving Throw save or suffer (3d6+9) Piercing Damage damage and 1d6 Bleed Damage ((6d6+18) Piercing Damage damage on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Psychokinetic Trumpet
offensiveAbilities.description:
The teraphant lets out a loud trumpet that deals 8d8 Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 27 Will Saving Throw save) in a 30ft Cone. A creature that fails its save is also pushed 15 feet (30 feet on a critical failure).

If a pushed creatures strikes a solid barrier, it takes 3d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage and stops.

The teraphant can't use Psychokinetic Trumpet again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Trample
offensiveAbilities.description:
Large or smaller, foot, Basic DC 27 Reflex Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster Strides up to double its Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures of the listed size, Trampling each creature whose space it enters. The monster can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single use of Trample. The monster deals the damage of the listed Strike, but trampled creatures can attempt a basic Reflex save at the listed DC (no damage on a critical success, half damage on a success, double damage on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Grabbing Trunk
offensiveAbilities.description: A Medium or smaller creature hit by the teraphant's trunk is grabbed. If the teraphant moves, it can bring the grabbed creature along with it.
